name: URINE SUGAR
description: Urine Sugar detects glucose in urine to screen for diabetes mellitus and other glucose metabolism disorders. This test uses glucose oxidase reaction.
literatureReview: Urine Sugar detects glucosuria using glucose oxidase-peroxidase reaction. Normal: negative. Abnormal: trace, 1+, 2+, 3+, 4+. Indicates blood glucose >180 mg/dL (renal threshold). False positives with oxidizing agents or strong acids. False negatives with ascorbic acid, ketones, or improper storage. Not reliable for diabetes screening - use blood glucose. Positive result requires blood glucose confirmation. Used in monitoring diabetic control, detecting renal glycosuria, and screening for inborn errors of metabolism. Critical for diabetes management and metabolic disorder diagnosis.
